description: Optional sending settings for a Twilio or Telnyx connection, all off unless turned on: quietHours (hold texts outside quietStart–quietEnd, default 8 and 20, in the recipient's local time worked out from their number; a reply to someone who wrote in the last 24 hours is not held), optOutList (keep the STOP / START texts people send on the brand's opt-out list and skip those numbers), consentCheck (say in a send's answer when a number has no consent record). On Twilio, messagingServiceSid (MG…) is the Messaging Service used to schedule texts. Called with none of them, it returns the current settings. Free. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: set_sms_settings
title: SMS sending settings
